A standalone program cannot report the post-termination state of its initial thread when the explicitly permitted termination impact may end the entire process; an external lifecycle observer is required.
All termination impacts are allowed subject to implementation documentation, so a standalone program cannot check the documentation obligation or exclude any particular process outcome.
